text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that standing be prohibited from 3:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Rosewell Avenue, between Lawrence Avenue West and a point 108 metres south and on the east side between a point 92 metres south of Lawrence Avenue West and a point 37 metres further south. Currently parking is allowed for a maximum of one-hour, from 7:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, in this area. The proposed standing prohibition will address traffic congestion and enhance safety on Rosewell Avenue during the dismissal time of Havergal College Junior School.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing from 3:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Rosewell Avenue, between Lawrence Avenue West and a point 108 metres south. 2.
